owner_requirements: LFM3_RECIPE_20261028.md data curation (35/20/15/15/15) and the owner's 2026-10-28 prioritization: most diverse, deepest-call-graph, most natlang-centric and Neuralese-using samples first; directory reducers count toward tier 1 with their own family cap; single joint natlang + Neuralese stage; held/dev never train. v2 (owner/coordinator 2026-10-28): tiers are ordering and weights only, not a filter: no near-duplicate, family or category caps (exact duplicates are still collapsed); drop only rows with no natlang structure at all or invalid rows (unverified, failed action, holds, zero own-output targets); a bounded coding mix (coding_mix, its own lowest tier, interleaved through the run) from generic coding sources.
sample: one native graph row: a whole-trajectory chain or a program-header decision (renders), a verified teacher action turn (teacher twins), or a producer/consumer graph (communication); call-graph features are those of the sample's whole source trajectory

features.verified: every decision of the sample has an accepted root outcome with an accepted oracle where recorded (communication graphs: their source e2e cohort rows' outcome)
features.invocations: distinct natlang invocations of the trajectory
features.max_depth: longest parent chain (root = 0) over host-captured parent edges
features.max_branching: most child invocations of one invocation
features.distinct_functions: distinct called functions (signature name + normalized instructions)
features.natlang_idioms: decisions using awaited nl, per-item nl, iterateOn, decide or callable folders
features.natlang_action_share: characters of natlang program actions (eval code, typed return_result, runtime tools) over all output characters of the trajectory (a character proxy for assistant tokens)
features.neuralese_edges: producer->consumer edges in the graph row (genuine native Neuralese)
features.text_neuralese_markers: text-emulated Neuralese marker spans in teacher actions (emulation, not native state)
features.reducer: directory-reducer use: reducer kind/modality or Folder first parameter; with folder_apply_calls and reducer_iterate_cursor
features.near_duplicate_cluster: sha256 of the root task normalized instructions (digits -> 0, whitespace collapsed, first 400 chars) joined with the sample's first source group (world): the same task text over the same world
features.choice_call: decision / scored-judge / progress-judge call kinds (family or task shape matches judge|decision|decide|refine|progress)

drop_rules.reason: no natlang program structure at all (no eval, typed natlang call, natlang action, Neuralese or decision/judge choice)

tiers.name: deep or branching, natlang idioms, Neuralese or reducer
deep or branching (or reducer) with natlang idioms
natlang idioms or typed natlang calls
verified natlang program actions (eval, typed answer or decision)
coding mix (generic coding, no natlang structure; sampled by coding_mix)

ordering: tier 1 cohorts (and communication) carry training_priority 1: they are scheduled first (communication lane interleaved with the urgent lane); tiers 2-4 have priority 0 and follow in manifest order (tier 2 first)
weighting: tier t gets loss mass natlang_share * rows(t) * tier_weight(t) / sum_t rows * tier_weight; each (tier, category) cell is written as max(1, round(mass(t) * rows(t,c)/rows(t) / cohort_unit)) equal cohort files, and own-outputs/1 family_balance (source-cohort) gives every cohort file equal loss mass
category_caps_rule: per tier, a category keeps at most ceil(share/100 * rows of that tier after the cluster and family caps) rows (highest fit first): the 35/20/15/15/15 idiom split is a cap, not a target (owner, LFM3_COMMITTED_DECISIONS_20261028.md #4); no rebalancing runs
learner_data: pre-tokenized native graph cohort files (token ids, target weights) plus the exact packed-capacity geometry sidecar built on DGX (build_native_packed_geometry.py); learners do no tokenization (decision #9)

held_carve.rule: a source group is held when sha256(salt+group) < fraction, closed over groups shared by this version's new train rows (renders and teacher twins); a component touching any group an earlier version trained on is never carved; carved rows are held (split test, conversion.held_carve) in every version; beyond max_rows they are dropped, never trained

zero_target_rows: refused (not written), counted in mixture.json cap_drops

serving_mode.rule: train/held rows come from program-header or whole-trajectory (program-header) renderings; teacher twins rendered with the full system prompt are excluded until re-rendered in program-header mode (coverage audit G7)

oracle_regrade_hold.reason: coordinator 2026-10-28 (oracle repairs cd26eb512): edit_stream and contract_diagnosis rows graded by the old exploitable oracles stay out of the LFM3 mixture until the oracle agent regrade passes them; reference replays (static-lambda etc., correct by construction) stay

category_split_note: the 35/20/15/15/15 category split is reported, not enforced (v2: no caps)

coding_mix.reason: owner 2026-10-28: a small diverse coding mix, ~10% of the joint-SFT supervised tokens (scales with the natlang total); verified rows, own-outputs targets, one row per near-duplicate cluster, round-robin over repositories/tasks; render only the sampled subset after the teacher twins and tier-1 members; codeagent and first-wave are natlang directory-reducer ports (port_record_calls) and go through the normal tiers (2026-10-28 correction)
